🏡 Thinking about buying a new construction home near Fort Hood?
Whether you're PCSing to Fort Hood, using a VA loan, or relocating from another state, there are things every buyer should know before signing a builder contract.

At Fort Hood Housing Group, we help military families compare builders, negotiate incentives, and confidently purchase homes throughout:
📍 Killeen
📍 Harker Heights
📍 Belton
📍 Temple
📍 Salado
📍 Copperas Cove

We specialize in:
✅ PCS Relocation
✅ VA Loan Home Buying
✅ Virtual Home Tours
✅ New Construction
✅ First-Time Military Buyers

📲 Ready to start your home search? We'd love to help!
